blocks.text: Predictive modeling (andaza lagane wali modeling) data se aane wale nataij ka andaza lagati hai. Machine learning models pichhle data ke patterns parakhte hain, aur yeh patterns batate hain ke aage kya ho sakta hai. Predictive models bohat se shobon mein istemal hote hain aur planning (mansooba bandi) aur faislon mein madad dete hain. Predictions probability (imkaan, kitna mumkin hai) par mabni hoti hain, aur hamesha yeh nahi batatin ke koi cheez kyun hoti hai. Is liye causality (sabab, yani wajah aur asar) samajhna bhi zaroori hai. Analysis mein dono concepts saath istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Mausam ke andaze (weather prediction) jaisi misalein dein. Talaba se poochein ke kya andaza wajah (cause) bhi batata hai. Dono ke farq par baat karein.
